name: ditto-flutter
description: Ditto Flutter SDK assistance — iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and web apps: pubspec setup, connecting, authentication, transports, subscriptions, DQL execution, observers with streams and widgets, attachments, presence, platform permissions and testing. Covers Ditto SDK 4.14.x (LTS), 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2.0

interface.shortDescription: Build and troubleshoot Ditto Flutter apps on mobile, desktop and web.
defaultPrompt: Add Ditto to this Flutter app with an observer feeding a widget.
Generate a runnable Flutter project that syncs a collection with Ditto.
Diagnose why my Flutter release build cannot sync.
